Panera Bread in Indian Land, SC, is a fantastic choice for anyone looking for a healthy and delicious meal in a cozy environment. Whether you're stopping in for a quick bite, meeting friends for coffee, or spending some time working, Panera offers a consistently good experience. This Panera is the best ever!  The staff are super friendly and welcoming each time I go (which is basically every day).  The new menu is very tasty as well.  Great updates on there. Ordered this new sandwich on the menu "The Spicy Take". I thought "well this is a bit new and different. Sure!" I got home to open this box which contained some unfortunate piece of chicken completely absent of any moistness. The remainder of the sandwich had some dab of some white sauce which didn't even make a dent in the arid experience of this meal. I suppose it was the Aioli but it was so minute if it had any taste it wouldn't have mattered. Speaking of lack of moisture, there was nothing spicy about this sandwich at all as it seemed to lack any of sauce advertised. And not a single fried pickle. Almost everything that could have been done wrong to a sandwich happened here which is sad considering Panera is a bread and sandwich shop. I do give it an extra star for the bread and a pretty piece of lettuce despite how long this poor thing must have sat under a warm light.

This by far is the most tasteless sandwich I've ever eaten. Like ever. Truly the first bad experience I've had at Panera. I know the cost of things have gone up - over $12 for this and chips.
